about_the_game:
PRO ELEVEN – Game Introduction

PRO ELEVEN is an online multiplayer football game where you control one single player and build a team together with real players from around the world.
Anyone can become the main character on the pitch.
Every moment that unfolds is shaped entirely by your decisions and your play.

Build Your Own Player, Create Your Own Football

From appearance and position to stats and skills —
your player is your own creation.

Perform well in matches, earn experience,
upgrade your stats, learn new skills, and craft your unique playstyle.
Bit by bit, your player grows into exactly the kind of footballer you envisioned.

  • 14 different attributes

  • Position-based development routes

  • Skills that define your playstyle

Every match can change your player’s career.
Experience the journey of a real footballer.

Your Football, Made Through Your Own Hands

PRO ELEVEN features a completely different control system from traditional football games.
Use your mouse cursor to set direction, click to pass or shoot,
and use your keyboard to adjust speed — bringing the play you imagine directly onto the pitch.

  • Natural movement based on cursor direction

  • Click to pass, shoot, and head

  • Simple yet deeply controllable gameplay

  • Execute the movements exactly as you envision them

It may feel unfamiliar at first, but once it clicks,
you’ll find yourself saying:
“Wait… I’m actually playing real football.”

A Team That’s Truly a Team

There is no AI-created teamwork here.
Every player on the field is a real person — your teammate.
(The goalkeeper is currently controlled by AI, with full player control planned in the future.)

Each player holds their position, trusts their teammates,
builds up play together, rotates in defense,
and creates moments that only real teamwork can produce.

  • Up to 20 players (10 vs 10) in real-time matches

  • Full 11 vs 11 player-controlled matches planned

  • Natural position-based gameplay

  • Strategy and communication directly impact victory

No one can win alone —
this is the pure essence of football.

Still in Development

PRO ELEVEN is an actively evolving project.
Animations, AI, network systems, and many core features are continuously being improved,
with player feedback shaping the direction of development.

What’s Coming Next

  • Player-controlled goalkeepers → full 11 vs 11 implementation

  • Advanced matchmaking system

  • More refined position/stat-based balancing

  • Additional skills and items

  • Club system and league system

  • Improved graphics and animation quality

PRO ELEVEN aims to grow alongside its players
and become a long-lasting online football platform built with the community.

 **The pitch is ready.

Your play is all that’s missing.**

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
